purpose: Evaluate semantic planning and grounded analytics safety without training on runtime answers or SQL.
snapshot_rule: Only a separately approved immutable snapshot with matching snapshot ID, integrity hash, timezone, and canonical time boundary may score outcome or execution accuracy.
training_rule: Only approved train cases with a semantic plan may be exported by default. Outputs contain question/context and semantic plan only.
security_rule: Do not store raw SQL, answers, production logs, credentials, personal data, or unredacted production snapshot rows.
